input.subject: Unit 14 (Tanya Mitchell) — full status ahead of your owner review
input.body:
Brooke,

Ahead of your owner review, here's where Tanya Mitchell's Unit 14 stands end-to-end as of July 1 so nothing catches you off guard. Short version: the owner sign-off we were waiting on is done and the eviction is cleared to file — but the account is not paid off and the unit is not back in our possession yet, so the turn hasn't started and can't until we recover the unit.

ACCOUNT
- June rent went past grace; first late notice issued 6/6. A payment plan was put in place and then breached — Tanya missed the 6/23 installment and made no contact.
- A 3-day notice to pay or quit was served (~6/26-27); the cure deadline (6/29) passed uncured, with no tenant response through any channel.
- Balance is still outstanding — carried-forward arrears + accumulated late fees + June rent. Note: QuickBooks does not yet have an itemized invoice/ledger for her, so I don't have a clean dollar total to quote — flagging that as something to nail down.
- Owner (Linda Castillo) authorized the eviction filing on 6/30 (ticket EVF-2026-014). Eviction tracking now reads "Owner Approved – Ready to File," and the filing package is staged.

WHAT'S NOT DONE YET (the part I want to confirm before we treat this as behind us)
- I don't have confirmation that the forcible-detainer petition has actually been filed with the JP court, and there is no court/hearing date on the calendar yet.
- The unit has not been legally vacated and we have not recovered possession.
- Per our own 3-day-notice assessment: no make-ready work is ordered until the unit is legally vacant, and any partial payment the tenant tenders should be held (not accepted) pending attorney guidance so we don't waive the eviction.

TURN / MAKE-READY
- The make-ready record ("Unit 14 – Tanya Mitchell Eviction") is deliberately still at SCHEDULED — not started. I updated its notes to reflect the above; I did not advance it, because the facts don't support it yet. Crew mobilizes the day we have possession.
- The Target Ready date on the record (5/1) is a stale placeholder; a real date can't be set until we have the unit back.

OPEN ITEMS TO CLOSE
1. Confirm the petition was actually filed and get the JP court/hearing date.
2. Resolve the unit-label discrepancy — her file shows "Unit 4B," "Unit 214," and "Unit 14" across records; we need one designation of record for the court paperwork.
3. Get an itemized ledger/balance into QuickBooks for accurate owner reporting.
4. Reconcile the two related Airtable make-ready rows (the "Unit 14 – Tanya Mitchell Eviction" row and the separate "Tanya Mitchell – Eviction Track" row).

HOUSEKEEPING
- Posted a clean status in #make-ready so the crew and front office are aligned.
- Refreshed the open account ticket (MT-2026-0184) so it isn't stale.
- Set myself a calendar reminder to revisit this early next week.

I'd rather confirm the filing and possession before we escalate or commit any vendor resources. Take a look and let me know how you want to play it.

Thanks,
Lisa
